verses.en: And the famine was sore in the land.
verses.pt: E a fome era grande na terra.
verses.en_web: The famine was severe in the land.
verses.en_bbe: Now the land was in bitter need of food.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que quando acabaram de comer o trigo que trouxeram do Egito, disse-lhes seu pai: Voltai, e comprai para nós um pouco de alimento.
verses.en_web: When they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, “Go again, buy us a little more food.”
verses.en_bbe: And when the grain which they had got in Egypt was all used up, their father said to them, Go again and get us a little food.

verses.en: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.pt: E respondeu Judá, dizendo: Aquele homem nos advertiu com ânimo decidido, dizendo: Não vereis meu rosto sem vosso irmão convosco.
verses.en_web: Judah spoke to him, saying, “The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’
verses.en_bbe: And Judah said to him, The man said to us with an oath, You are not to come before me again without your brother.

verses.en: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:
verses.pt: Se enviares a nosso irmão conosco, desceremos e te compraremos alimento:
verses.en_web: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food,
verses.en_bbe: If you will let our brother go with us, we will go down and get food:

verses.en: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.pt: Porém se não lhe enviares, não desceremos: porque aquele homem nos disse: Não vereis meu rosto sem vosso irmão convosco.
verses.en_web: but if you’ll not send him, we’ll not go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’”
verses.en_bbe: But if you will not send him, we will not go down: for the man said to us, You are not to come before me if your brother is not with you.

verses.en: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
verses.pt: E disse Israel: Por que me fizestes tanto mal, declarando ao homem que tínheis mais irmão?
verses.en_web: Israel said, “Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?”
verses.en_bbe: And Israel said, Why were you so cruel to me as to say to him that you had a brother?

verses.en: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
verses.pt: E eles responderam: Aquele homem nos perguntou expressamente por nós, e por nossa parentela, dizendo: Vive ainda vosso pai? Tendes outro irmão? E lhe declaramos conforme estas palavras. Podíamos nós saber que havia de dizer: Fazei vir a vosso irmão?
verses.en_web: They said, “The man asked directly concerning ourselves, and concerning our relatives, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ We just answered his questions. Is there any way we could know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down?’”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, The man put a number of questions to us about ourselves and our family, saying, Is your father still living? have you another brother? And we had to give him answers; how were we to have any idea that he would say, Come back with your brother?

verses.en: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.
verses.pt: Então Judá disse a Israel seu pai: Envia ao jovem comigo, e nos levantaremos e iremos, a fim que vivamos e não morramos nós, e tu, e nossos filhos.
verses.en_web: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.
verses.en_bbe: Then Judah said to Israel, his father, Send the boy with me, and let us be up and going, so that we and you and our little ones may not come to destruction.

verses.en: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:
verses.pt: Eu sou fiador dele; a mim me pedirás conta dele; se eu não o devolver a ti e o puser diante de ti, serei para ti o culpado todos os dias:
verses.en_web: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever,
verses.en_bbe: Put him into my care and make me responsible for him: if I do not give him safely back to you, let mine be the sin for ever.

verses.en: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
verses.pt: Que se não nos tivéssemos detido, certo agora teríamos já voltado duas vezes.
verses.en_web: for if we hadn’t delayed, surely we would have returned a second time by now.”
verses.en_bbe: Truly, if we had not let the time go by, we might have come back again by now.

verses.en: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
verses.pt: Então Israel seu pai lhes respondeu: Pois que assim é, fazei-o; tomai do melhor da terra em vossos vasos, e levai àquele homem um presente, um pouco de bálsamo, e um pouco de mel, aromas e mirra, nozes e amêndoas.
verses.en_web: Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this. Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;
verses.en_bbe: Then their father Israel said to them, If it has to be so, then do this: take of the best fruits of the land in your vessels to give the man, perfumes and honey and spices and nuts:

verses.en: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:
verses.pt: E tomai em vossas mãos dobrado dinheiro, e levai em vossa mão o dinheiro que voltou nas bocas de vossos sacos; talvez tenha sido erro.
verses.en_web: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.
verses.en_bbe: And take twice as much money with you; that is to say, take back the money which was put in your bags, for it may have been an error;

verses.en: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
verses.pt: Tomai também a vosso irmão, e levantai-vos, e voltai àquele homem.
verses.en_web: Take your brother also, get up, and return to the man.
verses.en_bbe: And take your brother and go back to the man:

verses.en: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.
verses.pt: E o Deus Todo-Poderoso vos dê misericórdias diante daquele homem, e vos solte ao outro vosso irmão, e a este Benjamim. E se eu tiver de ser privado de meus filhos, assim seja.
verses.en_web: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”
verses.en_bbe: And may God, the Ruler of all, give you mercy before the man, so that he may give you back your other brother and Benjamin. If my children are to be taken from me; there is no help for it.

verses.en: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
verses.pt: Então tomaram aqueles homens o presente, e tomaram em sua mão dobrado dinheiro, e a Benjamim; e se levantaram, e desceram ao Egito, e apresentaram-se diante de José.
verses.en_web: The men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and got up, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
verses.en_bbe: So they took what their father said for the man, and twice as much money in their hands, and Benjamin, and went on their journey to Egypt, and came before Joseph.

verses.en: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.
verses.pt: E viu José a Benjamim com eles, e disse ao mordomo de sua casa: Mete em casa a esses homens, e degola um animal, e prepara-o; porque estes homens comerão comigo ao meio-dia.
verses.en_web: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, “Bring the men into the house, and butcher an animal, and prepare; for the men will dine with me at noon.”
verses.en_bbe: And when Joseph saw Benjamin, he said to his chief servant, Take these men into my house, and make ready a meal, for they will take food with me in the middle of the day.

verses.en: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.
verses.pt: E fez o homem como José disse; e meteu aquele homem aos homens em casa de José.
verses.en_web: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And the servant did as Joseph said, and took the men into Joseph's house.

verses.en: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
verses.pt: E aqueles homens tiveram temor, quando foram metidos na casa de José, e diziam: Pelo dinheiro que voltou em nossos sacos a primeira vez nos trouxeram aqui, para virem contra nós, e nos atacar, e tomar por servos a nós, e a nossos asnos.
verses.en_web: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”
verses.en_bbe: Now the men were full of fear because they had been taken into Joseph's house and they said, It is because of the money which was put back in our bags the first time; he is looking for something against us, so that he may come down on us and take us and our asses for his use.

verses.en: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,
verses.pt: E aproximaram-se do mordomo da casa de José, e lhe falaram à entrada da casa.
verses.en_web: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,
verses.en_bbe: So they went up to Joseph's chief servant at the door of the house,

verses.en: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:
verses.pt: E disseram: Ai, senhor meu, nós em realidade de verdade descemos ao princípio a comprar alimentos:
verses.en_web: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.
verses.en_bbe: And said, O my lord, we only came down the first time to get food;

verses.en: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que quando viemos ao lugar de parada e abrimos nossos sacos, eis que o dinheiro de cada um estava na boca de seu saco, nosso dinheiro em seu justo peso; e o devolvemos em nossas mãos.
verses.en_web: When we came to the lodging place, we opened our sacks, and behold, each man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.
verses.en_bbe: And when we came to our night's resting-place, on opening our bags we saw that every man's money was in the mouth of his bag, all our money in full weight: and we have it with us to give it back;

verses.en: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.
verses.pt: Trouxemos também em nossas mãos outro dinheiro para comprar alimentos: nós não sabemos quem pôs nosso dinheiro em nossos sacos.
verses.en_web: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”
verses.en_bbe: As well as more money, with which to get food: we have no idea who put our money in our bags.

verses.en: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
verses.pt: E ele respondeu: Paz a vós, não temais; vosso Deus e o Deus de vosso pai vos deu o tesouro em vossos sacos: vosso dinheiro veio a mim. E tirou a Simeão a eles.
verses.en_web: He said, “Peace be to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I received your money.” He brought Simeon out to them.
verses.en_bbe: Then the servant said, Peace be with you: have no fear: your God, even the God of your father, has put wealth in your bags for you: I had your money. Then he let Simeon come out to them.

verses.en: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
verses.pt: E aquele homem levou àqueles homens na casa de José: e deu-lhes água, e lavaram seus pés: e deu de comer a seus asnos.
verses.en_web: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.
verses.en_bbe: And the servant took them into Joseph's house, and gave them water for washing their feet; and he gave their asses food.

verses.en: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
verses.pt: E eles prepararam o presente antes que viesse José ao meio-dia, porque haviam ouvido que ali haviam de comer pão.
verses.en_web: They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.
verses.en_bbe: And they got ready the things for Joseph before he came in the middle of the day: for word was given to them that they were to have a meal there.

verses.en: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
verses.pt: E veio José a casa, e eles lhe trouxeram o presente que tinham em sua mão dentro de casa, e inclinaram-se a ele em terra.
verses.en_web: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.
verses.en_bbe: And when Joseph came in, they gave him the things which they had for him, and went down to the earth before him.

verses.en: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?
verses.pt: Então ele lhes perguntou como estavam, e disse: Vosso pai, o ancião que dissestes, passa bem? Vive ainda?
verses.en_web: He asked them of their welfare, and said, “Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he yet alive?”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, How are you? is your father well, the old man of whom you were talking to me? is he still living?

verses.en: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
verses.pt: E eles responderam: Bem vai a teu servo nosso pai; ainda vive. E se inclinaram, e fizeram reverência.
verses.en_web: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.
verses.en_bbe: And they said, Your servant, our father, is well, he is still living. And they went down on their faces before him.

verses.en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.
verses.pt: E levantando ele seus olhos viu Benjamim seu irmão, filho de sua mãe, e disse: É este vosso irmão mais novo, de quem me falastes? E disse: Deus tenha misericórdia de ti, filho meu.
verses.en_web: He lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother, of whom you spoke to me?” He said, “God be gracious to you, my son.”
verses.en_bbe: Then, lifting up his eyes, he saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother's son, and he said, Is this your youngest brother of whom you gave me word? And he said, God be good to you, my son.

verses.en: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
verses.pt: Então José se apressou, porque se comoveram suas entranhas por causa de seu irmão, e procurou onde chorar: e entrou-se em sua câmara, e chorou ali.
verses.en_web: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and wept there.
verses.en_bbe: Then Joseph's heart went out to his brother, and he went quickly into his room, for he was overcome with weeping.

verses.en: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
verses.pt: E lavou seu rosto, e saiu fora, e controlou-se, e disse: Ponde pão.
verses.en_web: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, “Serve the meal.”
verses.en_bbe: Then, after washing his face, he came out, and controlling his feelings said, Put food before us.

verses.en: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.pt: E puseram para ele à parte, e separadamente para eles, e à parte para os egípcios que com ele comiam: porque os egípcios não podem comer pão com os hebreus, o qual é abominação aos egípcios.
verses.en_web: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians, that ate with him, by themselves, because the Egyptians don’t eat bread with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.
verses.en_bbe: And they put a meal ready for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians who were with him by themselves; because the Egyptians may not take food with the Hebrews, for that would make them unclean.

verses.en: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
verses.pt: E sentaram-se diante dele, o mais velho conforme sua primogenitura, e o mais novo conforme sua idade menor; e estavam aqueles homens atônitos olhando-se um ao outro.
verses.en_web: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled one with another.
verses.en_bbe: And they were all given their seats before him in order of birth, from the oldest to the youngest: so that they were looking at one another in wonder.

verses.en: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
verses.pt: E ele tomou iguarias de diante de si para eles; mas a porção de Benjamim era cinco vezes como qualquer uma das deles. E beberam, e alegraram-se com ele.
verses.en_web: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph sent food to them from his table, but he sent five times as much to Benjamin as to any of the others. And they took wine freely with him.
